description: With immediate_respawn on: walk east holding W and die (/kill): the client asks to respawn while handling the death and again from Gui.tick the next tick (dead, no screen open), and is back at the spawn point (4 -60 4) the tick after, still walking (closing the level loading screen reads the held keys again). Then jump, die in the air, and come back the same way.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
